title: Generate a Clarity datagrid component
description: Creates a standalone Angular component with a configured <clr-datagrid>: typed columns, client-side, server-driven or virtual-scroll rows, pagination, selection, batch and row actions, and row details.

name.description: Name of the component, in kebab-case. May include a directory, e.g. `users/users-list`.
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for the datagrid component?

columns.description: Comma-separated columns as `field[:type]`, where type is string (default), number, date or boolean. Example: `name,age:number,createdAt:date,active:boolean`.
columns.x-prompt: Which columns should the datagrid have? (comma-separated `field[:string|number|date|boolean]`)

mode.description: client: all rows in memory, the datagrid sorts, filters and pages (`*clrDgItems`). server: the backend sorts, filters and pages, the component handles `(clrDgRefresh)`. virtual-scroll: all rows in memory, rendered with `ClrVirtualScroll`, no pagination.

pagination.description: Add a footer with `clr-dg-pagination` and a page size selector. Ignored for virtual-scroll.

filter.description: Add the built-in string and number filters to the string and number columns. Requires sort.

selection.description: Row selection: none, single or multi.

actionBar.description: Add a `clr-dg-action-bar` with batch action buttons that act on the selected rows. Implies multi selection when no selection is given.

rowActions.description: Add a `clr-dg-action-overflow` menu with per-row actions.

detail.description: Row details: expandable rows (`clr-dg-row-detail`) or a detail pane (`clr-dg-detail`).

hideableColumns.description: Let users show and hide columns (`*clrDgHideableColumn`).

compact.description: Use the compact row density (`clr-density="compact"` on the datagrid).

animations.description: Add `provideAnimationsAsync()` to the project's app.config.ts when no animations provider is set up. The datagrid needs one at runtime.

path.description: Directory to create the component in, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to the project's `src/app`.

project.description: Name of the project in angular.json. Defaults to the first application.

prefix.description: Selector prefix. Defaults to the project's prefix, or `app`.

flat.description: Create the files directly in `path` instead of a folder named after the component.
